    return sum(m.req_rate / m.slo for m in mlist) / free

def _kvpr(mlist):
    """KVPR of a single GPU's model list."""
    free = GPU_MEM_SIZE - sum(m.model_size for m in mlist)
    if not mlist or free <= 0:
        return 0.0
    return sum(m.req_rate / m.slo for m in mlist) / free


def _refine(p):
    """Hill-climb: move or swap a model off the worst-KVPR GPU when it lowers max KVPR."""
    for _ in range(len(p) * 4):
        k = {g: _kvpr(p[g]) for g in p}
        src = max(p, key=lambda g: k[g])
        cur = max(k.values())
        if k[src] <= 0:
            break
        improved = False
        for m in list(p[src]):
            for dst in p:
                if dst == src:
                    continue
                dst_free = GPU_MEM_SIZE - sum(x.model_size for x in p[dst])
                # try moving m to dst
                if m.model_size <= dst_free:
                    p[src].remove(m); p[dst].append(m)
                    if max(_kvpr(p[g]) for g in p) < cur - 1e-12:
                        improved = True; break
                    p[dst].remove(m); p[src].append(m)
                # try swapping m with a model on dst
                for m2 in list(p[dst]):

                    src_free = GPU_MEM_SIZE - sum(x.model_size for x in p[src])
